# Frozen OJP answers for `tests/test_my_places.py`

Address and place searches recorded by the `OJP probe` workflow on 2026-11-12, copied here so the test does not change when the probe refreshes `tests/fixtures/ojp/`.

`app_lir_address_entrances.xml` is a recorded answer whose address was replaced by a public example (names, postcode, positions); it keeps the main number and its building entrances (60, 60.1 … 60.5) that the app must merge.
